alt: Raymond, Bilbo og Bæver forbinder to ordremapper med ét fælles syltetøjskatalog. Små varelinjekort med samme brombærmærke danner forbindelserne.
prompt: ONE standalone complete 1536×1024 landscape (3:2), richly detailed warm painted LUP storybook scene with gouache and softly brushed oil on textured paper. Use exact canonical mascot likenesses from attached local references, exactly THREE main characters with natural plausible limbs and readable faces. Concrete learning activity rather than a text chart. No readable text, headings, digits, fake code, watermark, external logo, borders or multiple panels. Teach normalization of orders, line items and product catalog. The scene is a rustic open-air JAM MARKET WORKBENCH under a sage green linen canopy, warm spring sunlight on a riverside village courtyard and blackberry planters in soft background. At center rear of workbench an upright oak product CATALOG STAND holds EXACTLY ONE LARGE main product card showing a blackberry jam jar with a single purple berry pictogram, plus a single real jar on the narrow display ledge. Clearly shared catalog, no other large product cards anywhere. At front left and front right on the workbench lie EXACTLY TWO distinct open order sleeves, teal-blue left and ochre right, each open toward the viewer, recognizable different orders. Between each order sleeve and shared center catalog is a SMALL line-item card with only a tiny matching purple blackberry pictogram and one plain empty tiny square field; these two cards are much smaller than product card. Use a short thin brass cord running visibly from each order sleeve through its small line-item card toward the ONE shared product-card stand, the two routes converging. The original product description has one home and is referenced by both orders. Keep this precise three-part visual large and uncluttered. Raymond from first ref is friendly blue elephant professor, round bronze glasses, brown eyes, blue tuft and curled trunk, cream knit cardigan over blue shirt and brown trousers, stands left holding pointer over one connecting cord, two arms only. Bilbo from second ref is short rosy adult hobbit with dense chestnut curls, pointed ears and tiny chin tuft, green velvet vest with brass buttons, rolled ivory sleeves and rust cropped trousers, hairy bare feet clearly on paving, stands at center rear holding the real single jam jar near the shared product card. Bæver from third ref is round brown beaver, prominent incisors, dark square spectacles, flat crosshatched tail, blue blazer, cream shirt, brown trousers and boots, stands right checking the second sleeve with a pencil and small blank notebook, exactly two furry arms. All participants work together, warm attentive faces, no computers, unnecessary duplicate paper cards or extra front props.
